title: Testing Whether In-Context Inoculation Examples Prevent In-Context Emergent Misalignment

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: No finetuning required. ICL misalignment uses in-context examples at inference time. Modifying the framing of context examples is simple prompt engineering. Highly accessible for beginners.
